content.short: Switch settles USDC and USDT across 30+ local currencies with same-day settlement.
content.description: Switch moves USDC and USDT in and out of more than thirty local currencies, settling in minutes where a correspondent banking transfer takes days. Developers integrate HTTP APIs with SDKs and a sandbox for testing, then pay out from stablecoin wallets into recipient bank or mobile money accounts. A developer fee can be set per transaction.
content.meta: Move stablecoins in and out of 30+ local currencies in minutes rather than days.
